name: Noice
description: Thumbs up beside your face + a tongue click: the Noice clip pops up and your video punch-zooms.
whatHappens: The Noice clip pops up in the corner with its sound, and your video punch-zooms on your face right as he says “noice”.
how: Hold a thumbs up next to your face and click your tongue. Without a mic, hold the thumbs up next to your face for about a second.
tips: A thumbs up at chest height won’t trigger it, so ordinary thumbs-ups in a meeting stay safe.
